baseline_models.focus_anchor: The full construction from Knower through Mighty and Wise.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge discloses what is concealed and what is present, while might makes that knowledge effective and wisdom makes its exercise right-directed.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower supplies comprehensive cognition.
Concealment from sight supplies the inaccessible pole.
Presence with observation supplies the accessible pole.
Invulnerable strength turns cognition into effective agency.
Knowledge that hits the right judgment directs that agency.

changed_reading.before: Four adjacent divine attributes, with unseen and seen as a static pair.
changed_reading.after: A causal sequence: exhaustive disclosure feeds effective, right-directed agency.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The transition from الغيب to الشهادة to العزيز الحكيم.
baseline_models.mechanism: A hidden matter becomes knowledge-bearing testimony; enforceable strength and judgment then answer evidence rather than mere visibility.

activation_trace.role: A fact screened from observers supplies the evidentiary problem.
Knowledge-bearing declaration converts presence into evidence.
Overcoming force supplies enforceability after disclosure.
Adjudication supplies the decision made from that evidence.

changed_reading.before: الشهادة means only the visible world.
changed_reading.after: الشهادة can also activate an evidentiary register in which hidden facts become declarable and actionable.

baseline_models.mechanism: Dominating strength is paired with wisdom branches of restraint, repair, and the bridle, making power internally governed rather than merely supplemented by intelligence.

activation_trace.role: Conquest and overpowering supply potentially unbounded force.
Restraint that prevents corruption gives force a reparative limit.
The bridle concretizes wisdom as force held and steered.

changed_reading.before: Might and wisdom are two independent excellences.
changed_reading.after: Wisdom governs the manner and limit of might from within.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus pair الغيب والشهادة shifts from two cosmic regions to a dynamic boundary between inward source and outward deed: disposition, intention, and secrecy become form, announcement, and observable action.

activation_trace.role: Concealment anchors the inward side of the focus contrast.
Observed presence anchors the outward side of the contrast.
Purposive action supplies an outwardly accountable product.
Inner discernment shows that perception itself has an inward register.
Inward disposition supplies a latent human source.
Formed appearance supplies that source's manifest counterpart.
Keeping something inward names the concealed phase directly.
Public emergence names the manifest phase directly.
The source from which acts issue links interior to exterior.

structural_cues: 64:2 couples عمل with perception, 64:3 pairs inward constitution with form, and 64:4 explicitly opposes secrecy and announcement.
The focus ayah closes by compressing this repeated interior-exterior structure into الغيب والشهادة.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inner disposition, intended action, secrecy, publicity, and an issuing source; I infer an inner-to-outer arrow, while a static two-domain totality remains live.

changed_reading.before: God knows two separately named domains, unseen and seen.
changed_reading.after: God knows the whole emergence of an act, from concealed inward source through public, witnessable form.

context_deltas.mechanism: News, clarifying signs, reawakening, a visible beacon, and knowledge of an affair's interior turn الشهادة into mediated evidence; what is presently unseen can cross into accountable disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Present inaccessibility supplies what communication must bridge.
Knowledge-bearing testimony anchors disclosure as evidence.
A report arriving from elsewhere carries absent facts into hearing.
Speech or sign that opens meaning supplies inspectable proof.
Rousing what lay still supplies deferred manifestation.
A conspicuous beacon makes guidance publicly orienting.
Knowledge reaching an affair's interior preserves depth behind evidence.

structural_cues: 64:5-8 move through prior report, messengers with clarifiers, resurrection and reporting, then a sent-down light and knowledge of deeds.
The sequence repeatedly converts absence or futurity into communicated presence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reports, signs, awakening, light, and interior knowledge; I infer an evidentiary chain across time, while a non-forensic communication reading remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The witnessed is whatever is immediately visible.
changed_reading.after: The witnessed also includes truth made answerable through report, sign, resurrection, and disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Day of mutual loss gathers dispersed lives and exposes misvaluation: deliberate work becomes evidence, concealed liabilities can be covered, and the focus knowledge spans hidden present value and final public settlement.

activation_trace.role: Hiddenness anchors value not yet apparent to participants.
Evidentiary disclosure anchors the eventual settlement.
Judgment supplies authoritative resolution of exposed value.
Gathering scattered parts creates one field for reckoning.
Transactional shortchanging supplies the valuation asymmetry.
Loss through heedlessness explains why the asymmetry stayed latent.
Intended work supplies the item whose value is disclosed.
Covering fault supplies a merciful adjustment within settlement.

structural_cues: 64:9 repeats day three times and gathering twice before naming mutual loss.
Belief and work precede covered wrongs and enduring entry, giving disclosure a consequential order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, transactional diminishment, heedless loss, work, and covering; I infer a delayed settlement of value, while plain eschatological assembly remains sufficient.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge merely includes a future day not yet seen.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge already holds the true valuation that gathering will expose as witnessed settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: A calamity that lands, permission that bounds it, and guidance that turns the heart activate wisdom as calibrated governance of impact and inward response, not detached observation of an event.

activation_trace.role: Accurate wisdom anchors calibration rather than bare causation.
A hit that reaches its target supplies event-level impact.
The split mapping preserves affliction as exhausting human experience.
Authorization supplies a boundary on occurrence.
Gentle direction supplies an orienting response rather than mere pain.
Turning something from one face to another makes inward revision concrete.
Repeated disclosure to the knower closes the event-heart sequence.

structural_cues: 64:11 places permission after the incident and heart-guidance after conditional belief.
The ayah ends by repeating the focus root ع ل م across every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies impact, permission, conditional belief, guidance, and heart-turning; I infer a governed incident-to-response arc, but it does not state that pain itself causes guidance.

changed_reading.before: The Knower observes calamity and the heart as separate objects.
changed_reading.after: The Wise Knower encompasses both impact and the contingent inward reorientation that can follow it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Bounded human delivery ends where divine custody begins: a clear message becomes witnessed, refusal can turn away, and the unresolved unseen result is entrusted to the capable Knower.

activation_trace.role: Declared evidence anchors the delivered and answerable portion.
Unassailable capacity makes the ultimate trustee sufficient.
Turning away supplies the response outside the messenger's control.
Conveying the message defines the messenger's bounded task.
Meaning opened by word or sign makes delivery public.
One who undertakes and preserves supplies adequate custody.
Settled trust of heart supplies the human handoff.

structural_cues: 64:12 limits the messenger to clear delivery after possible refusal.
64:13 immediately redirects believers toward reliance on God alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies limited delivery, refusal, and commanded reliance; I infer that the final titles retrospectively name the adequate trustee, while a simple exhortation to trust remains live.

changed_reading.before: The closing attributes describe God without changing the communication scene.
changed_reading.after: They complete a handoff: manifest delivery belongs to the messenger, while hidden outcome belongs to the knowing, capable trustee.

context_deltas.mechanism: Family hostility calls for alertness, yet the triple movement of relinquishing penalty, turning the page, and protective covering prevents vigilance from becoming retaliation; العزيز الحكيم becomes power disciplined toward repair and mercy.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering capacity supplies the force that could retaliate.
Restraint against corruption redirects force toward repair.
Hostility supplies a genuine relational threat.
Wakeful precaution keeps mercy from becoming naivety.
Relinquishing punishment interrupts retaliatory force.
Graceful turning from fault changes the social direction.
Protective covering blocks the fault's continuing effect.
Tender mercy names the positive end of restraint.

structural_cues: 64:14 holds warning and three nonretaliatory verbs in one conditional sequence.
The divine pair غفور رحيم follows the human practices before العزيز الحكيم closes the surah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies threat, caution, three releases, and mercy; I infer that the closing titles govern this ethic of controlled power, while they may simply be final praise.

changed_reading.before: The Mighty can defeat enemies and the Wise selects the response.
changed_reading.after: Might is shown as strong enough to remain vigilant without being captured by retaliation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Trial assays the concealed self: avarice holds value inward, spending makes it leave, and the loan cuts off a portion for return. Visible transfer thus becomes testimony to a motive known before it appears.

activation_trace.role: Concealment anchors motive before action reveals it.
Evidence-bearing manifestation anchors the outward transfer.
Assaying metal or persons supplies a test that reveals composition.
Money going out supplies the observable act of release.
The reason and apprehension within the self supply hidden motive.
Eager withholding supplies the inward resistance under assay.
A severed share advanced for recompense makes release costly and legible.

structural_cues: 64:15 names wealth and children as trial; 64:16 moves from capacity to hearing, obedience, spending, self, and avarice.
64:17 repeats the loan root before promising increase and covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, inner self, withholding, outward expenditure, and an advanced share; I infer that giving evidences motive, while the acts can be read without psychological sequencing.

changed_reading.before: The Knower sees private motive and public charity as two known facts.
changed_reading.after: The Knower sees the hidden composition that the witnessed act of costly release assays and discloses.

context_deltas.mechanism: A deliberately surrendered share is returned with increase while fault is covered; gratitude makes a small input visibly fruitful and forbearance delays seizure. Might supplies capacity for return, while wisdom calibrates multiplication and mercy.

activation_trace.role: Strengthening another supplies capacity to enlarge the return.
Tight construction and precision supply calibrated rather than arbitrary return.
An advanced cut awaiting recompense supplies the exchange structure.
Addition by a matching amount supplies multiplication.
Protective covering adds mercy rather than only payment.
A little becoming sufficient and visibly effective supplies responsive amplification.
Deliberate self-restraint supplies patience within the return.

structural_cues: 64:17 orders loan, multiplication, covering, then the titles grateful and forbearing.
64:18 immediately follows with knowing, might, and wisdom, extending the chain from response to capacity and calibration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies advance, increase, covering, responsive fruitfulness, and restraint; I infer a governed return mechanism, while each title may remain an independent predicate.

changed_reading.before: Might and wisdom close an isolated promise of reward.
changed_reading.after: They name the capacity and calibration behind a return that can multiply value, cover fault, and wait with restraint.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates concrete marker and buried-root branches rather than the ordinary attribute gloss. It remains anchored in all three focus roots and offers a coherent inference from hidden depth to visible indicator; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for knowing, not as a lexical replacement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عالم الغيب والشهادة as a relation between hidden depth and indicative mark.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark supplies the observable clue used by knowing.
Buried roots supply a hidden structure recoverable beneath appearance.
A sign that bears witness supplies surface indication.
Tight coherence makes the inferred hidden structure hold together.

changed_reading.before: Knowing is direct possession of hidden and visible objects.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, knowing also reads manifest marks as witnesses to concealed structure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-root reversal is surprising because concealment changes moral sign: denial covers truth, expiation and forgiveness cover fault protectively. It remains anchored in الغيب and الحكيم as knowledge and discrimination of hidden acts; prose should qualify it as a contextual contrast, not claim the roots are synonyms.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الغيب الحكيم as knowledge of concealment and wise discrimination among its uses.

activation_trace.role: Being screened supplies the neutral state whose moral direction varies.
Accurate discernment supplies discrimination among unlike coverings.
Covering truth supplies culpable concealment.
Covering fault supplies restorative concealment within the same root family.
Protective covering of fault supplies merciful concealment.

changed_reading.before: The unseen is a morally uniform category of hidden things.
changed_reading.after: The Wise Knower distinguishes concealment that suppresses truth from concealment that shields a person from a fault's effect.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The flow-and-cultivation mechanism is branch-distant and should not be rendered as the verse's direct meaning. It remains focus-anchored because hidden circulation becomes witnessed yield under knowing, strength, and precision, and the adjacent packet supplies every material step; retain it as an as-if model only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الغيب والشهادة العزيز الحكيم as hidden circulation becoming manifest yield under capable ordering.

activation_trace.role: Concealed movement anchors circulation before visible yield.
A manifest indicator anchors yield as witness.
Strengthening supplies the power that enlarges released value.
Precise construction supplies ordered channels and return.
A visible entrance with a hidden outlet supplies concealed flow.
Ground holding back its runoff materializes avaricious blockage.
A cultivator splitting earth supplies release that enables growth.
Cutting off a portion supplies the opening action.
Fresh shoots emerging supply witnessed fruit from hidden process.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge simply includes private and public financial acts.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the closing names knowledge of blocked or hidden circulation and of the yield made visible when value is released.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The bridle image is unusually concrete and form-distant, but it is rooted directly in حكيم and reinforced by caution, graceful release, and forbearance. Downstream prose should say wisdom functions as if it bridles might, never define الحكيم by this image alone.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: العزيز الحكيم as overpowering capacity held, steered, and delayed.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering force supplies what requires governance.
A bridle supplies the concrete image of held and steered force.
Graceful turning from fault supplies redirected social movement.
Patient self-command supplies delay rather than immediate seizure.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, wisdom is the bridle by which irresistible power remains controlled, directional, and patient.

strongest_changes: الغيب والشهادة became a process from concealed inward source to witnessed action, not only a pair of realms.
Reports, signs, gathering, and mutual loss turned knowledge into an evidentiary and delayed-valuation mechanism.
Pardon, assay, spending, multiplication, and forbearance recast might and wisdom as restrained, calibrated response.
summary.what_was_special: The closure repeatedly acted as a mechanism rather than a title list: it knew emergence, judged disclosure, distinguished kinds of covering, and governed how hidden motive becomes visible consequence. Concrete branches preserved subsurface, bridle, assay, and flow readings without forcing them into one synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: الشهادة may remain primarily manifest presence rather than testimony in several models.
The inner-to-outer and incident-to-heart arrows are reader inferences, not explicit causal claims in the packet.
The hydraulic, cultivation, buried-root, and bridle images are diagnostic analogies rather than stable lexical glosses.
